tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Window ground behind the floating panels and the empty conversation.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Floating panels: folder rail, chat list, info panel, dialogs.

tokens.name: chat
tokens.usage: Conversation background behind bubbles.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Incoming bubbles, service cards, composer field, inline evidence.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows, rail items and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Open chat row, active folder, selected claim. text and muted both read on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Search and composer field borders (3:1 or better on panel and raised in both themes).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on window, panel, chat, raised, hover and selected.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Previews, timestamps, labels, captions on panel, chat, raised, hover and selected (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary buttons, links, active rail label, sender names of moyyi, cited-source tags. Ink navy in light, periwinkle in dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: key
tokens.usage: Inline keyboard buttons under a message and quiet chips.

tokens.name: on-key
tokens.usage: Labels on key fills.

tokens.name: out
tokens.usage: Your own message bubbles.

tokens.name: on-out
tokens.usage: Text in your own bubbles.

tokens.name: out-2
tokens.usage: Second stop of the outgoing bubble gradient (out at top left, out-2 at bottom right). on-out reads on both stops.

tokens.name: out-meta
tokens.usage: Time and receipt marks inside your own bubbles, on out and out-2.

tokens.name: wallpaper-a
tokens.usage: Wallpaper gradient, top left stop. Only behind bubbles; text never sits on it directly.

tokens.name: wallpaper-b
tokens.usage: Wallpaper gradient, bottom right stop.

tokens.name: wallpaper-mark
tokens.usage: Bubble-shaped pattern drawn over the wallpaper gradient. Decorative.

tokens.name: unread
tokens.usage: Unread message count on a chat you follow. Any size, written in full up to 9999.

tokens.name: on-unread
tokens.usage: Number on an unread badge.

tokens.name: reaction
tokens.usage: Reaction pill under a bubble.

tokens.name: on-reaction
tokens.usage: Count and label in a reaction pill.

tokens.name: reaction-mine
tokens.usage: Reaction pill the person added themselves.

tokens.name: on-reaction-mine
tokens.usage: Count and label in the person's own reaction pill.

tokens.name: working
tokens.usage: Presence dot on an AI avatar while it works. Colour-only cue: the row or header also says 正在做 somewhere on screen.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.usage: Presence dot on a paused AI.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Waiting for your decision, partial evidence, cannot undo, unknown outcome. Always with words.

tokens.name: on-attention
tokens.usage: Text on an attention badge.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Stop, pause an AI, a claim you marked wrong, failed steps.

tokens.name: quiet-badge
tokens.usage: Counter for things that can wait (running jobs in 在做). Never for decisions.

tokens.name: on-quiet-badge
tokens.usage: Number on a quiet badge.

tokens.name: avatar-ink
tokens.usage: Fill of the 核查 avatar and other dark-role avatars.

tokens.name: on-avatar-ink
tokens.usage: Letter on avatar-ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every control.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and the evidence sheet.

tokens.name: sheen
tokens.usage: Light caught by liquid glass: the top rim and the sheen from above. Only mixed in at low strength, never a fill.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Shadow under liquid glass. Only mixed in at low strength, never a fill.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Top of the folder rail or list header only.

styles.name: profile-name
styles.usage: Name under the large avatar in the info panel and dialog titles.

styles.name: row-name
styles.usage: Chat row title and chat header title.

styles.name: row-preview
styles.sample: 写作：参考文献用哪个格式？
styles.usage: Two-line preview under the row title, in muted.

styles.name: row-time
styles.usage: Time at the row's top right, in muted, tabular figures.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Counter inside a badge, tabular figures.

styles.name: message
styles.sample: 合同第 2 页提到附件二，PDF 里没有这一页。

styles.name: sender
styles.sample: 核查 · 不同意 1 处
styles.usage: Sender line at the top of a group bubble.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Time and receipt inside a bubble.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: 这个决定不修改文件，可以在手机上回复。
styles.usage: Notes under cards and controls, provenance lines (出处：…), in muted.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headings inside the info panel and dialogs.

styles.name: mono
styles.sample: pandoc 合同要点.md -o 合同要点.pdf
styles.usage: Commands, paths in change messages, file previews.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between grouped bubbles from the same sender.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between inline keyboard buttons; bubble to its keyboard.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps inside rows (title to preview) and between chips.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between messages from different senders; panel gutters between floating panels.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Bubble padding (10 by 12), row padding (10).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Row avatar to text; card padding; composer padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel padding, info panel section gaps.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Conversation side padding below 900px.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Conversation side padding; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Large separations: empty states, info panel top.

tokens.name: radius-tail
tokens.usage: The one bubble corner nearest the sender (bottom left incoming, bottom right outgoing).

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Source tags, memory chips, file attachments inside bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Inline keyboard buttons, primary buttons, fields.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Chat rows, rail items, project avatars at 40 to 48px.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Bubbles and message cards (with radius-tail on one corner).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Floating panels and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, date pills, AI avatars (circles).

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Folder rail. Hidden below 900px; folders become a horizontal strip above the list.

tokens.name: list-width
tokens.usage: Chat list panel.

tokens.name: info-width
tokens.usage: Info panel, opened from the header's info button. Overlays the chat below 1200px.

tokens.name: avatar-list
tokens.usage: Avatar in chat rows.

tokens.name: avatar-message
tokens.usage: Sender avatar beside group messages.

tokens.name: avatar-profile
tokens.usage: Avatar at the top of the info panel.

tokens.name: bubble-max
tokens.usage: Maximum bubble width in the conversation column.

tokens.name: sticker-size
tokens.usage: Sticker square in a conversation; 96px inside the sticker picker.

tokens.name: column-max
tokens.usage: Conversation column cap on wide windows.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons on phone; 32px on desktop.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, badge count change.

tokens.name: duration-move
tokens.usage: Panel open, sheet rise, message insert. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.
